notes.title: Playtesting Announcement | Sign Up Now
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45328654/9c9000d6b260bff35f28d47370cc2c91d33db7e7.png[/img]
We’re opening up limited playtesting for Arcane Drifter—and you’re invited.

This is your chance to explore the cursed mine, experiment with the game’s unique real-time, card-based combat, and help shape the experience with your feedback. Whether you're here for the story, the strategy, or the thrill of breaking the system wide open—we want you in.

🧪 Spots are limited, and we'll be sending out demo keys starting April 14th.
⚠️ First come, first served—so don’t wait.

👉 [url=https://arcanedrifter.com/playtest.html?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=playtest_announcement]Sign Up Here[/url]

notes.title: It’s Official! Our Steam Page Is Live 🚀 (No turning back now!)
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
This week we’re thrilled to announce that the Steam page for Arcane Drifter is officially live! 🎉

Even the Drifter is excited...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45328654/654f19d1660629551140c1189b75b930f33bf345.gif[/img]

...Okay, "excited" might be a stretch—he’s a stoic kinda fella. But this is what he looks like when he’s really feeling it. (Also, I’m an indie dev, so “giddy dancing” animations are still a dream. Maybe someday...)

This marks the start of an exciting journey, and we’d love for you to join us. Here’s how you can get involved:

🌟 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3230770]Wishlist the Game[/url]: It helps us out tremendously by signaling interest to us and Steam.
🗨️ [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3230770/discussions/]Join the Discussion[/url]: Share your thoughts, feedback, and questions—head over to the discussion board and join the conversation!
🤝 [url=https://discord.gg/DyUZn3YGmc]Join Our Discord[/url]: Get exclusive updates, sneak peeks, and connect with fellow adventurers.
📢 [url=https://twitter.com/HardResetDev]Follow Us on X[/url]: Stay in the loop with bite-sized updates, behind-the-scenes looks, and announcements.

This is my first indie game, so expect a few mishaps and entertaining explosions along the way.

We’re committed to keeping you updated on the game’s progress every step of the way. As our first order of business, we’ll be sharing a roadmap soon to give you a clear view of what’s ahead for Arcane Drifter.

Thank you for being part of this journey!
